assertions.issues: PUT /v1/config/correlation returns 500 due to read-only Docker filesystem mount. Workaround: edit config file on host and POST /v1/config/reload. This is a deployment configuration issue, not a code bug — the PUT endpoint works correctly but the Docker Compose config mounts /etc/prefixd as read-only.

frictions.description: PUT /v1/config/correlation returns 500 because the Docker Compose config mounts the configs directory as read-only. Had to edit the YAML file on the host and use POST /v1/config/reload instead.
frictions.resolution: Used host file editing + POST /v1/config/reload as workaround. Config reload propagation was verified successfully.

frictions.description: Groups tab defaults to 'Open' status filter, which showed no groups because all open groups had expired. Had to manually switch filter to 'Resolved' to find groups with mitigations for navigation testing.
frictions.resolution: Changed status filter dropdown from 'Open' to 'Resolved' to access groups with linked mitigations.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: all 5 passed. VAL-DASH-008 (group detail) shows all required elements including header, events timeline, confidence breakdown, corroboration badge, and linked mitigation. VAL-DASH-012 (mitigation correlation) correctly shows Correlation card for correlated mitigations and hides it for non-correlated ones. VAL-DASH-015 and VAL-CROSS-004 confirm bidirectional group↔mitigation navigation works with client-side routing. VAL-CROSS-005 confirms config reload propagation (source weight change reflected in new events).
